game.title: Dragon Age: Inquisition
game.blurb: Open-world fantasy role-playing game from BioWare (with BioWare Edmonton), released 2014-11-18. RAWG average playtime: 4 hours. Genres: Action, RPG, Strategy. Chapters are an estimate drawn from Steam achievement themes.

chapters.title: The Main Story
chapters.summary: From the prologue and the Breach to ending the threat for good. Spoiler-guarded.

chapters.title: Companions, Romance and the Orlesian Court
chapters.summary: Recruiting companions, friendships, romance and winning over the court.

chapters.title: Running the Inquisition
chapters.summary: The war table, agents, keeps, requisitions, Skyhold decorations, thrones and Inquisition rank.

chapters.title: Exploration and Collecting
chapters.summary: Camps, shards, veilfire runes, astrariums, rifts, codex entries, herbs, mounts and the Solasan temple.

chapters.title: Combat, Abilities and Crafting
chapters.summary: Abilities, specializations, combos, dragons, crafting, alchemy, levels and gold.

chapters.title: Stone-Bear Hold and the Old Temple (DLC block)
chapters.summary: The Avvar of Stone-Bear Hold, the Old Temple, a legendary figure and an ancient myth.

chapters.title: The Deep Roads (DLC block)
chapters.summary: The Legion of the Dead camp, Shaper Valta, an ogre alpha and the earthquakes.

chapters.title: Hard, Nightmare and the Trials
chapters.summary: Finishing on Hard or Nightmare, and the eight Trial achievements played with game modifiers turned on.

chapters.title: Statues, the Taken Shape and a Last Story Step
chapters.summary: Three achievements at the end of the list: a story step, the ancient statue caches and the Taken Shape items.

notes: Backlog game, picked from RAWG's most-added list for its year (docs/PLAN.md section 2 ordering). StrategyWiki has a page at completion stage 0; only Controls and a short Table of Contents (Gameplay, Controls, Walkthrough) exist, and the walkthrough is not written. dragonage.fandom.com answers the API, with about 241 linked pages; names only were looked at, nothing copied. The Steam app is 1222690 ("Dragon Age Inquisition"); RAWG lists PC, PS3, PS4, Xbox 360 and Xbox One. None of the 69 Steam achievements is hidden. Achievements 51 to 54 (Stone-Bear Hold, the Old Temple) and 55 to 58 (the Deep Roads, Shaper Valta) look like two DLC blocks; RAWG's search results list DLC entries called "Jaws of Hakkon", "The Descent", "Trespasser" and "Dragonslayer", but the achievement data does not say which block is which, so the chapters are named after the places the achievements mention. "Historian", "Winter's End" and "Giant Slayer" were placed by schema position. Achievements 59 to 66 are "Trial of ..." goals played with named modifiers on. The last three ("Forever Marked", "Lateral Thinker", "Coroner") are grouped by position and may belong to a third DLC; this needs checking. RAWG's 4-hour average playtime looks low for this game but is what RAWG reports.
